name: flexifeed-studio-server
description: Lightweight Server-Driven UI API & Responsive Studio Backoffice

scripts.test: tsc --noEmit && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['data/feed.json', 'data/presets/mega-sale.json', 'data/presets/tech-weekend.json'].forEach(f => { const d = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); if (!d.screen || !d.sections) throw new Error('Invalid DSL: ' + f); }); console.log('✔ All SDUI DSL files & presets valid!');"
